newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends flat in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends flat in quiet trading.

text.p: * Canada's dollar ended flat on Wednesday at C$1.3735 (US$0.7280) in quiet trading on the back of subdued activity in bond and stock markets, dealers said.
* They said the currency would likely enjoy support ahead of the C$1.3710 (US$0.7294) level, where there was strong interest to buy U.S. dollars.
Overnight the Canadian dollar gained as the U.S. dollar strengthened in European trading, touching a 41-month high against the German mark.
Analysts said that longer term, North American currencies were benefiting from the belief that European monetary union would produce a soft Euro currency.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar fell to 82.10 Japanese yen from 82.40 at Tuesday's close. The dollar firmed to 1.2820 German marks from 1.2816 marks on Tuesday.
